transcript:
Agent: Good morning, my name is Priya from XYZ Finance. Am I speaking with Mr. Anil Sharma regarding your personal loan account number PL0056789?
Customer: Yes, this is Anil. What is it now?
Agent: Mr. Sharma, I am calling regarding your overdue EMIs. You have three pending installments for your personal loan, which amounts to approximately INR 31,500, plus the late fees, bringing the total outstanding to INR 33,250. Your last payment was due on July 5th.
Customer: Hmm, I know, I know.
Agent: We understand that sometimes circumstances can be difficult, Mr. Sharma. We want to help you regularize your account. Would you like to discuss a flexible payment plan or a partial payment option today to avoid further late charges and impact on your credit score?
Customer: Look, Priya, honestly, I get multiple calls every day about this. I've heard all the options. Right now, I am really not interested in discussing it over the phone. You people call so much.
Agent: I understand your concern about the calls, sir. We are just trying to help you find a solution. If you could make even one EMI payment today, we can certainly reduce the call frequency. What can you pay today?
Customer: No, no. As I said, I am simply not interested. Whatever offers you have, please send them to me by email. I much prefer emails and don't want any more calls for this, okay? Just stop calling.
Agent: But Mr. Sharma, sometimes direct conversation can help clarify things instantly, and emails might be missed. Are you sure you don't want to hear about a potential settlement offer that might help you close the account at a reduced amount?
Customer: Thank you, but my decision is final. I'm not interested in discussing this on the phone. I will check my emails. Please just mark my account, no more calls.
Agent: Understood, Mr. Sharma. So, just to confirm, you are not making any payment commitment today, and you are requesting us to stop calling you?
Customer: Yes, exactly. No more calls. Only emails please.
Agent: Okay, Mr. Sharma. We will note your preference. However, please be aware that without a payment or a commitment, we might have to explore other options as per the loan agreement. You will continue to receive official communications via email and post.
Customer: Alright. Goodbye.
Agent: Thank you for your time, Mr. Sharma. Have a good day.
L3: Identity Confirmed – Borrower Verified on Call|Complains of Excessive Call Frequency|Special / System – Do Not Contact
